say:1:1028101002:0.text: Thank you for removing the corruption.

say:3:1028102001:0.text: Nice to see you, Miss Hewynn! You sound a little weak... has your magic not recovered? But the corruption's gone...
say:3:1028102001:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐，真高兴见到你！你的声音有些虚弱，是魔力还没恢...

say:4:1028102002:0.text: Maintaining the purifying rain has overdrawn my magic. Some of it has dissipated with the rainfall.
say:4:1028102002:0.source_cn: 我……维持净化之雨透支了我的魔力……有些魔力随雨水散逸...

say:5:1028102003:0.text: ... so I have yet to fully recovered.
say:5:1028102003:0.source_cn: 所以……我现在还没有完全恢复。

say:6:1028102004:0.text: Can't you get back your lost magic?
say:6:1028102004:0.source_cn: 把散逸掉的魔力找回来不就行了吗？

say:7:1028102005:1.text: In theory, yes. However, the magic that I've lost is somewhat... special. Difficult to recover by ordinary means.
say:7:1028102005:1.source_cn: 理论上是的。可是我散逸的魔力有些……特殊，很难用普通方...

say:8:1028102006:1.text: Your magic, Miss Hewynn, what makes it so special?
say:8:1028102006:1.source_cn: 咦，伊温小姐的魔力有什么特别的地方呢？

say:9:1028102007:1.text: My magical essence is... water. To sustain the purifying rain, my emotions and fragments of memories are tied to the rain itself.
say:9:1028102007:1.source_cn: 我的魔力本源是……水。为了维持净化之雨，我的情感和一些...

say:11:1028102008:1.text: If this magic is reabsorbed without care, it might be destroyed... and I don't want to lose memories that are dear to me...
say:11:1028102008:1.source_cn: 如果粗蛮地吸收魔力，可能反而会破坏它们……那些是很重要...

say:12:1028102009:1.text: It is said that "memories flow like water". This reminds me of Hewynn's magic.
say:12:1028102009:1.source_cn: 都说“记忆如水”……原来伊温小姐的魔法原理是这样。

choice_prompt:13:1028102009.text: It is said that "memories flow like water". This reminds me of Hewynn's magic.
choice_prompt:13:1028102009.source_cn: 都说“记忆如水”……原来伊温小姐的魔法原理是这样。

say:14:1028102010:1.text: Hmm... I remember reading in Basic Theory of Magic that memory-related magic can be retained if you find a catalyst relative to the memory.
say:14:1028102010:1.source_cn: 嗯……我记得在《魔法基础构成理论》中读到过，关于记忆的...

say:15:1028102011:1.text: In addition, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can help Hewynn control this flow of magic, so there should be no problems!
say:15:1028102011:1.male: In addition, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can help Hewynn control this flow of magic, so there should be no problems!
say:15:1028102011:1.female: In addition, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can help Hewynn control this flow of magic, so there should be no problems!

choice_prompt:16:1028102011.text: In addition, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can help Hewynn control this flow of magic, so there should be no problems!
choice_prompt:16:1028102011.source_cn: 再加上<style=stress><player_name></style>可以帮伊温小姐精妙地控制魔力流动，应该就没有问题了！
choice_prompt:16:1028102011.male: In addition, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can help Hewynn control this flow of magic, so there should be no problems!
choice_prompt:16:1028102011.female: In addition, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> can help Hewynn control this flow of magic, so there should be no problems!

say:17:1028102012:1.text: Thank you... It seems I have to trouble you yet again.

say:18:1028102013:1.text: You don't need to be so courteous with us, Miss Hewynn. Do you know of anything that can be used as a catalyst for these memory fragments?
say:18:1028102013:1.source_cn: 不要这么客气嘛~那么，伊温小姐知道有什么东西可以作为稳...

say:19:1028102014:0.text: Let me think... <style="highlight">a crown of flowers</style> worn at a Taran wedding might suffice.
say:19:1028102014:0.source_cn: 和记忆有关的物品……我想，大概，我需要一顶塔兰村人在<...

say:20:1028102015:1.text: A crown of flowers? A strange custom for the people of Taran.
say:20:1028102015:1.source_cn: 花冠？塔兰村的婚礼竟然还有这种习俗呀。

say:21:1028102016:1.text: Leave it to us, Miss Hewynn! We're on the job!
say:21:1028102016:1.source_cn: 交给我们吧，伊温小姐，我们这就去找！

choice:16:1:2.text: Time for me to shine again!
choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 又到我大显身手的时候了！
choice:16:1:2.male: Time for me to shine again!
choice:16:1:2.female: Time for me to shine again!

choice:13:0:1.text: How can we protect these memories?
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 应该有保护记忆碎片的方法
choice:13:0:1.male: How can we protect these memories?
choice:13:0:1.female: How can we protect these memories?

choice:13:1:2.text: I know exactly how you feel!
choice:13:1:2.male: I know exactly how you feel!
choice:13:1:2.female: I know exactly how you feel!

say:0:1028103001:0.text: But where do you find a crown like that?
say:0:1028103001:0.source_cn: 不过我们要去哪里找到婚礼花冠呢？

say:1:1028103002:0.text: Look at this field of flowers! Let's make one!
say:1:1028103002:0.source_cn: 看看这满地的鲜花！我们来自己做一个吧！

say:1:1028104001:1.text: What a beautiful crown... Just like the ones in my memory.
say:1:1028104001:1.source_cn: 多漂亮的花冠，和我记忆中的那个很像呢。

choice_prompt:2:1028104001.text: What a beautiful crown... Just like the ones in my memory.
choice_prompt:2:1028104001.source_cn: 多漂亮的花冠，和我记忆中的那个很像呢。

say:4:1028104003:0.text: I'm beginning to sense where my magic has scattered... please wait a moment.
say:4:1028104003:0.source_cn: 我来感应魔力逸散的地方……请你们稍等一会儿。

say:5:1028104004:0.text: ...Found it! Near the village of Taran!

say:7:1028104005:0.text: Hooray! I was afraid the rain scattered Hewynn's magic far, far away!
say:7:1028104005:0.source_cn: 太好了！我还担心伊温小姐的魔力会随着雨水散逸到很远很远...

say:8:1028104006:0.text: Let's go to Taran Village now.
say:8:1028104006:0.source_cn: 我们现在就去塔兰村吧。

say:0:1028105001:0.text: Hey, look... is it that glowing thing over there?
say:0:1028105001:0.source_cn: 诶，你们瞧，是那个发光的东西吗？

say:2:1028105003:0.text: Hewynn, please prepare to absorb the magic. I'm going to activate the memory fragment.
say:2:1028105003:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐，请做好吸收魔力的准备，我要激活记忆碎片了。
say:2:1028105003:0.male: Hewynn, please prepare to absorb the magic. I'm going to activate the memory fragment.
say:2:1028105003:0.female: Hewynn, please prepare to absorb the magic. I'm going to activate the memory fragment.

say:2:1028108001:0.text: The Hypofiends are gone! Hewynn, can you keep going? Was the ritual ruined?
say:2:1028108001:0.source_cn: 魔物解决啦！伊温小姐，你还能继续吸收魔力吗，不会因为中...

say:11:1028108004:0.text: What's the matter, child? You look so sad.
say:11:1028108004:0.source_cn: 怎么啦，孩子？你看起来很难过。

say:13:1028108006:0.text: Don't be afraid, child. What is the matter? Has someone been unkind to you?
say:13:1028108006:0.source_cn: 孩子，别害怕。你怎么了，有谁欺负你了吗？

say:15:1028108008:0.text: You look ever so sad. Do not suffer in silence, dear. Speak up if something is troubling you.
say:15:1028108008:0.source_cn: 你看着伤心得很，唉，是不是受了什么委屈。孩子，要是心里...

say:17:1028108010:0.text: If you don't wish to speak, just cry, and you'll feel better.
say:17:1028108010:0.source_cn: 你要是不想说呀，那就大哭上一场，哭出来就能好。

say:19:1028108012:0.text: No, no, dear, don't be afraid to cry. Who can say they never have? Even at my age, I still cry sometimes. What's wrong with that?
say:19:1028108012:0.source_cn: 不怕、不怕，哭就哭了，谁还没哭过？哪怕长到我这么大岁数...

narration:23:1028108014:0.text: Hewynn cried as tears streaked down her face. Magical raindrops started falling from the sky.
narration:23:1028108014:0.source_cn: 伊温哭泣出声，她的泪水划过脸庞，天空中的雨滴也魔法般地落下。

say:25:1028108015:2.text: It's raining. Let's go back to the house. You shouldn't get wet.
say:25:1028108015:2.source_cn: 下雨了，我们先回屋，你不能淋雨的。

say:27:1028108016:0.text: Wait, dear... the rain seems so warm and soft... it seems to be lending me strength.
say:27:1028108016:0.source_cn: 等等……亲爱的，这雨淋在身上很舒服，很温暖……我好像有...

say:28:1028108017:0.text: Your cheeks are a bit rosier. Are you feeling better? Let me see... your hands are not so cold anymore!
say:28:1028108017:0.source_cn: 你的脸色红润了些，真的好点了吗？让我看看……你、你的手...

say:29:1028108018:0.text: It must have been Misarte who heard your cries. This wonderful rain... it must have come from the gods above!
say:29:1028108018:0.source_cn: 一定是弥萨忒听到了我们的祈求。太好了，这雨……这雨一定...

say:33:1028108019:0.text: ...Is this the power I unleashed? This divine rain...
say:33:1028108019:0.source_cn: ……这是，我释放出的力量吗？这些雨水……

say:34:1028108020:0.text: Does it require emotional resonance to awaken this... power of healing?
say:34:1028108020:0.source_cn: 是需要情绪共鸣才能唤醒的……“治愈”的力量吗……？

say:2:1028109001:0.text: Thanks to you, I was able to absorb the magic that escaped me.
say:2:1028109001:0.source_cn: 多亏了你们，这里逸散的魔力已经被我吸收了。

say:3:1028109002:1.source_cn: 那个，伊温小姐，刚才那段记忆是……

choice_prompt:4:1028109002.source_cn: 那个，伊温小姐，刚才那段记忆是……

say:5:1028109003:1.text: Sorry! Because Chippy saw Hewynn's memories, Chippy thinks she's a gentle person!
say:5:1028109003:1.source_cn: 对不起嘛，因为满满看到了伊温小姐的记忆，觉得伊温小姐是...

say:6:1028109005:1.text: It doesn't matter. For a long time, I didn't know how to master this power. Obviously, I was born of the water, but I couldn't figure out how to release its magic.
say:6:1028109005:1.source_cn: 没关系的。诞生后的很长时间，我都不知道怎么掌握力量……...

say:7:1028109006:1.text: It wasn't until I was brave enough to shed my tears that I realized that the magic of healing is the power of sharing and connecting. It takes emotional resonance to awaken.
say:7:1028109006:1.source_cn: 直到那天，我第一次勇敢地在别人面前哭泣，我才明白……“...

say:8:1028109007:0.text: Since then, this memory has become the source of my magic, the most vibrant ripple of light...
say:8:1028109007:0.source_cn: 从那以后，这段记忆就成为我魔法的源头，最潋滟的波光……

say:9:1028109008:0.text: Sorry, I'm getting caught up in my memories... I still need to find the next location where my magic was lost.
say:9:1028109008:0.source_cn: 啊，对不起，我自己陷入回忆里了……得快点找到第二处魔力...

choice_prompt:10:1028109008.text: Sorry, I'm getting caught up in my memories... I still need to find the next location where my magic was lost.
choice_prompt:10:1028109008.source_cn: 啊，对不起，我自己陷入回忆里了……得快点找到第二处魔力逸散的位置。

say:11:1028109009:1.text: No, this time, I'm ready... look.
say:11:1028109009:1.source_cn: 不，这一次，我已经准备好了……请看。

say:12:1028109010:0.text: A leaf from a hornleaf bear, huh?
say:12:1028109010:0.source_cn: 咦，那是叶角熊的叶子吧？

say:13:1028109011:0.text: This represents a very important memory...
say:13:1028109011:0.source_cn: 嗯，它也代表着一段很重要的记忆……

say:14:1028109012:0.text: The pull of magic... it's in that direction.
say:14:1028109012:0.source_cn: 这次魔力逸散的方位……是在这边。

choice:10:0:1.text: What do we need this time?
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 这次需要准备什么触媒？
choice:10:0:1.male: What do we need this time?
choice:10:0:1.female: What do we need this time?

say:16:1028109004:1.text: Oh my...! By the way, Hewynn, we shouldn't have looked at your memories!
say:16:1028109004:1.source_cn: 哎呀……！对了，伊温小姐，我们不该贸然窥视你的记忆！

say:1:1028110002:0.text: Yes, that should be it up ahead.
say:1:1028110002:0.male: Yes, that should be it up ahead.
say:1:1028110002:0.female: Yes, that should be it up ahead.

say:1:1028112001:1.text: I'm ready to absorb the magic.
say:1:1028112001:1.source_cn: 我已经准备好吸收散逸的魔力了。

choice_prompt:2:1028112001.text: I'm ready to absorb the magic.
choice_prompt:2:1028112001.source_cn: 我已经准备好吸收散逸的魔力了。

say:7:1028112004:0.text: You're hurt... Mr. Bear, I can heal you... Come closer and let me take a look...
say:7:1028112004:0.source_cn: ……咦，你受伤了……熊先生，可以让我来治疗吗？我，能不...

say:9:1028112006:0.text: Your wounds are bad... they must be so painful... I'm going to help you. You might get a little wet from the rain, but don't worry... it'll help.
say:9:1028112006:0.source_cn: 伤得好重，一定很难受吧……我要治疗了，可能会让你淋一点...

say:10:1028112007:0.text: Don't worry, it'll be better in a moment... Look! It's healing already!
say:10:1028112007:0.source_cn: 别着急，马上就好……瞧，已经开始愈合了！

say:12:1028112009:0.text: This honey...? Is it all for me?
say:12:1028112009:0.source_cn: 这些蜂蜜是……？都是给我的吗？

say:13:1028112010:0.text: That's sweet! Thank you, Mr. Bear!

say:14:1028112011:0.text: I'm Hewynn, by the way. Do you have a name?
say:14:1028112011:0.source_cn: 对了，我叫伊温，你有名字吗？

say:16:1028112013:0.text: You don't have a name? What if I call you "Softpaw", our big friend of the forest!
say:16:1028112013:0.source_cn: 没有名字啊……那我叫你“伊尔贡”好不好？伊尔贡，丛林里...

say:18:1028112015:0.text: Is this for me, too? What a beautiful leaf! Thank you, Softpaw!
say:18:1028112015:0.source_cn: 这也是送给我的吗？好漂亮的叶子……谢谢，伊尔贡！

say:19:1028112016:0.source_cn: 我们……是朋友了，对吧？我们是朋友了！

say:21:1028112018:0.text: You want me to rub your belly? Ha! So fluffy!
say:21:1028112018:0.source_cn: 你想……让我摸摸你？哈，毛绒绒的，好可爱……

say:25:1028112019:0.text: It's over? At least no monsters came...
say:25:1028112019:0.source_cn: ……咦，结束了？这次很顺利嘛，没有魔物来侵扰——

say:28:1028112021:0.source_cn: 满满就是随便说说……这、这可不能怪满满呀！

say:29:1028112022:0.text: Have no fear, Hewynn! We'll protect you!
say:29:1028112022:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐，不要担心，我们会保护你的！

say:3:1028114001:1.text: Could it be that the hornleaf bear from your memory is the same one we buried earlier...?!
say:3:1028114001:1.source_cn: 难道说，刚才回忆里那只叶角熊，是我们之前埋葬的那只叶角...

say:4:1028114002:0.text: Yes... Softpaw was my first friend.
say:4:1028114002:0.source_cn: ……是的。它……伊尔贡，是我的第一个朋友。

say:5:1028114003:0.text: He was very gentle, fluffy, and honest, but also very brave. His favorite food was honey. He trusted me...
say:5:1028114003:0.source_cn: 它很温柔，毛绒绒的，有一点点憨厚，可是很勇敢，最喜欢吃...

say:6:1028114004:0.text: But this time, I couldn't heal him... I...
say:6:1028114004:0.source_cn: 可这次，我没能来得及治好它……我……

choice_prompt:7:1028114004.text: But this time, I couldn't heal him... I...
choice_prompt:7:1028114004.source_cn: 可这次，我没能来得及治好它……我……

say:8:1028114007:1.text: Hewynn, you'll always have this memory of him.
say:8:1028114007:1.source_cn: 伊温小姐，它永远都会在你的记忆里陪着你。

say:9:1028114008:1.text: If you feel a sudden sweetness in your heart one day, it's probably him trying to give you honey!
say:9:1028114008:1.source_cn: 要是你哪天突然感到心头一甜，没准就是它在请你吃蜂蜜呢！

say:10:1028114009:0.text: Thank you all for your kind words. My grief will disappear one day, but not today...
say:10:1028114009:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们的安慰，我会慢慢走出悲伤的……

say:11:1028114010:0.text: I'm starting to feel my power return. Hopefully, I can recover the last of my lost magic without any issues.
say:11:1028114010:0.source_cn: 我的力量也开始恢复了，希望能顺利回收最后一处散逸的魔力……

say:12:1028114011:0.text: Hewynn, what kind of item do we need for your next memory?
say:12:1028114011:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐，这次需要什么样的物品来激活记忆碎片呢？

say:13:1028114012:1.text: A bellflower... I know where to find it.
say:13:1028114012:1.source_cn: 嗯，我想，需要一朵铃兰……我知道该去哪里找它。

say:16:1028114006:0.text: Don't worry. I can control my emotions.
say:16:1028114006:0.source_cn: 别担心，我会努力调整好情绪的。

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 冷静，你的魔力开始紊乱了

say:1:1028115002:0.text: Look, more of Hewynn's lost magic is here!
say:1:1028115002:0.source_cn: 看，伊温小姐散逸的魔力也在这里！

say:3:1028116001:0.text: Well... this is the magic bellflower Florabelle planted.
say:3:1028116001:0.source_cn: 嗯……这是芙拉贝尔种下的魔法铃兰。

say:4:1028116002:1.text: Just like Florabelle, this flower has a kind, gentle aura.
say:4:1028116002:1.source_cn: 真的，和芙拉贝尔一样，这朵花好美丽，还给人一种温柔的感觉呢。

say:5:1028116003:1.text: The lost magic must have been drawn to the bellflower!
say:5:1028116003:1.source_cn: 散逸的魔力也在这里。太神奇了，它一定是被这朵铃兰花吸引来的！

say:6:1028116004:1.text: Please activate the memory fragment... this is the final one.
say:6:1028116004:1.source_cn: 请开始激活记忆碎片吧，这是最后一处了。

choice_prompt:7:1028116004.text: Please activate the memory fragment... this is the final one.
choice_prompt:7:1028116004.source_cn: 请开始激活记忆碎片吧，这是最后一处了。

say:9:1028116006:0.text: This is the last of the lost magic. If the monsters come this time, they'll be even more wild.
say:9:1028116006:0.source_cn: 这是最后一处散逸的魔力，如果魔物是为了吞噬伊温小姐的力...

say:10:1028116007:0.text: Chippy will be on high alert!

say:11:1028116008:0.source_cn: 主人，开始激活记忆碎片吧！

choice:7:0:1.text: We'll be more careful this time.
choice:7:0:1.male: We'll be more careful this time.
choice:7:0:1.female: We'll be more careful this time.

say:2:1028117001:0.text: Hewynn, do you remember Lyca? She became a Dusk Patroller! And Bryon joined the Windwhisperers.
say:2:1028117001:0.source_cn: 伊温，你还记得莱卡吗？她成为薄暮巡游者了！布莱恩也加入...

say:3:1028117002:0.text: Lyca and Bryon? They're both great...
say:3:1028117002:0.source_cn: 莱卡姐姐和布莱恩大哥吗？他们都好棒啊……

say:4:1028117003:0.text: And then there's Lorsan, whom Master Arden accepted as a student. It's hard to say how much of a headache he'll become. He never follows the rules, that one...
say:4:1028117003:0.source_cn: 还有洛桑，雅顿大人收了他当学生，虽然不知道更头疼的会是...

say:5:1028117004:0.text: I heard he ventured out several times into the forest, but Master Arden had to pull him back by the ear each time.
say:5:1028117004:0.source_cn: 我听说呀，他做梦都想去丛林外闯荡，被雅顿大人揪着耳朵拎...

say:7:1028117006:0.text: By the way, Hewynn, would you like to venture out and explore?
say:7:1028117006:0.source_cn: 对了，伊温，你想出去看看吗？

say:9:1028117008:0.text: To other parts of Esperia beyond the Vaduso Mountains, to see the great plains and swirling seas?
say:9:1028117008:0.source_cn: 嗯，去瓦度索山脉之外，伊索米亚的其他地方，去看看大海和湖泊？

say:2:1028118001:0.text: Hewynn, why won't you answer me?!
say:2:1028118001:0.source_cn: 伊温，你为什么不回答我？！

say:4:1028118003:0.text: Even without your answer, I know you don't have the courage to journey to Lovers' Wish! You're a coward!
say:4:1028118003:0.source_cn: 不用你回答我也知道，你没有胆量踏出情人之愿，对不对？因...

say:5:1028118004:0.text: Your cowardice made you lose Softpaw, keeps you from Lovers' Wish, and is hurting the people of Taran.
say:5:1028118004:0.source_cn: 就是因为懦弱，你才会一直失去，伊尔贡，情人之愿的风景，...

say:6:1028118005:0.text: Florabelle... w-what's wrong with you? You're not well...
say:6:1028118005:0.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔……你、你怎么了？你不舒服吗？

say:7:1028118006:0.text: You're too weak! One day, you'll lose everything!
say:7:1028118006:0.source_cn: 你太弱小了，总有一天你会因此失去一切，无法挽回！

say:11:1028118008:0.text: Magister, Hewynn's memory... there's something wrong. Florabelle isn't an evil person!
say:11:1028118008:0.source_cn: 主人，伊温小姐的回忆……是不是哪里出错了？芙拉贝尔明明...
say:11:1028118008:0.male: Magister, Hewynn's memory... there's something wrong. Florabelle isn't an evil person!
say:11:1028118008:0.female: Magister, Hewynn's memory... there's something wrong. Florabelle isn't an evil person!

say:14:1028118010:0.text: That memory... Florabelle never said that!
say:14:1028118010:0.source_cn: 那段回忆……芙拉贝尔没有那么说过……绝对没有！

say:19:1028118015:0.text: Hewynn, don't let them influence you! Control your magic, or the memory fragment will break!
say:19:1028118015:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐，不要被污染影响了，控制好它，不然你的记忆碎片...

say:20:1028118016:0.text: Don't worry, we'll hold off the Hypofiends and keep them away!
say:20:1028118016:0.source_cn: 别担心，我们来挡住魔物，绝对不会让它们再影响到你！

choice:13:0:1.text: Something is wrong with the memory
choice:13:0:1.male: Something is wrong with the memory
choice:13:0:1.female: Something is wrong with the memory

say:23:1028118012:0.text: Those cursed Hypofiends are distorting Hewynn's memory!
say:23:1028118012:0.source_cn: 是那些可恶的魔物，它们在污染伊温小姐的魔力！

say:24:1028118013:0.text: No wonder... the memories were corrupted! Fake!
say:24:1028118013:0.source_cn: 怪不得……刚才的回忆被污染了，是假的！

say:2:1028119001:0.text: You're right... I'm not afraid of these Hypofiends or their foul tricks.
say:2:1028119001:0.source_cn: 你们说得对。这些魔物，污染，和扭曲的回忆……我不该害怕它们。

say:3:1028119002:0.text: The corruption here has been cleansed by our many companions. I can't save everyone by myself, but I will do the best I can.
say:3:1028119002:0.source_cn: 这里的腐化已经被很多很多的同伴一起清除了。我无法一个人...

say:4:1028119003:0.text: Water is the power of life and convergence... Droplets gather together to form a river of hope.
say:4:1028119003:0.source_cn: 水是生命和汇聚的力量。许多的水滴聚在一起，才是希望的河流。

say:5:1028119004:0.text: Alone, I'm weak, but as we gather together, we are strong!
say:5:1028119004:0.source_cn: 我是很弱小，可和这里的每一个人汇聚在一起，我们就会很强大！

say:7:1028119006:0.text: Thank you for keeping the Hypofiends at bay.
say:7:1028119006:0.source_cn: 嗯……谢谢你们阻拦这些魔物。

say:8:1028119007:0.text: Although I'm not at my full strength, please let me stand beside you and fight!
say:8:1028119007:0.source_cn: 虽然我的力量还没有完全恢复，但请让我和你们一起战斗吧！

say:9:1028119008:0.text: There's only one Hypofiend left! Hewynn, let's finish this together!
say:9:1028119008:0.source_cn: 只剩最后一只魔物了！伊温小姐，我们一起干掉它！

say:1:1028120001:1.text: That was a close call, but we're alright, thanks to you.
say:1:1028120001:1.source_cn: 刚才很危险，多亏有你们……

say:2:1028120002:1.text: Let me absorb the last of my lost magic and my final memory.
say:2:1028120002:1.source_cn: 让我把逸散的魔力完全吸收，看完最后的回忆吧……

choice_prompt:3:1028120002.text: Let me absorb the last of my lost magic and my final memory.
choice_prompt:3:1028120002.source_cn: 让我把逸散的魔力完全吸收，看完最后的回忆吧……

say:6:1028120003:0.text: Hewynn, have you thought of venturing out? Hmm... if I was asked to, I'd hesitate as well.
say:6:1028120003:0.source_cn: 伊温，你没想好要不要出去吗？嗯……这个问题要是问我的话...

say:7:1028120004:0.text: Florabelle, I... I want to stay here forever and help all creatures of the Taran River.
say:7:1028120004:0.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔，我……我想永远留在这里，帮助所有塔兰河抚育的生灵。

say:9:1028120006:0.text: How could that be? Wherever you are, your strength manifests in your gentle raindrops.
say:9:1028120006:0.source_cn: 怎么会呢？无论在哪里，你的力量都会化成温柔的雨滴。

say:10:1028120007:0.text: If they land on Lovers' Wish, they'll nurture the wildlife there, and if they fall into the Taran River, they'll drift and spread into the distance.
say:10:1028120007:0.source_cn: 落在情人之愿，就能滋润这里的花草；落在水中，就会随着塔...

say:11:1028120008:0.text: Hewynn, you're amazing. You know what you want most, and you go after it, which also takes courage!
say:11:1028120008:0.source_cn: 伊温，这样很好呀！你知道自己最想要的是什么，这也是一种勇气！

say:13:1028120010:0.text: Of course! It's brave to venture into the unknown but just as courageous to look within your heart and go for what you want.
say:13:1028120010:0.source_cn: 当然了！面对陌生和危险，大胆向前，这是勇气；但直面内心...

say:14:1028120011:0.text: Hewynn, you are braver than you know.
say:14:1028120011:0.source_cn: 伊温，你比你想象中更加勇敢。

say:19:1028120013:0.text: So this was Hewynn's real memory.
say:19:1028120013:0.source_cn: 原来……这才是伊温小姐真正的回忆。

say:20:1028120014:1.text: I've received many kind words from people, but this is the first time I've been called courageous.
say:20:1028120014:1.source_cn: 我听过许多不同的赞美，可那是第一次有人说我“有勇气”。

say:21:1028120015:0.text: From Florabelle, I learned that bravery is not only facing dangers from the outside world, but having the will to face myself.
say:21:1028120015:0.source_cn: 从芙拉贝尔那里我才知道，勇气不光是敢于挑战外界的危险，...

say:22:1028120016:0.text: Apologies... I can't linger on these memories. Please wait, I'll finish reclaiming my magic soon.
say:22:1028120016:0.source_cn: 抱歉……我总是忍不住沉浸在回忆中。请稍等，我马上就能将...

say:0:1028121001:0.text: Amazing... all my magic has been replenished.
say:0:1028121001:0.source_cn: 真好……所有的魔力都回收完了。

say:3:1028122001:0.text: Thank you all for helping me recover pieces of myself. I feel whole again.
say:3:1028122001:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们……逸散的魔力全部找回，我想，很快力量就能完全...

say:4:1028122002:0.text: And because of you, this land has been cleared of Hypofiends. Without my lost magic to draw them in, they won't return...
say:4:1028122002:0.source_cn: 而且多亏了你们，这附近的魔物也被清除干净了，没有魔力作...

say:5:1028122003:0.text: Now, everyone can live in peace.
say:5:1028122003:0.source_cn: 这样，大家就又可以开开心心、安安稳稳地生活了。

say:6:1028122004:0.text: This is all thanks to the magister. Of course, Chippy and Hammie helped too!
say:6:1028122004:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，主要是主人很厉害。当然啦，满满和漫漫也出了力的！
say:6:1028122004:0.male: This is all thanks to the magister. Of course, Chippy and Hammie helped too!
say:6:1028122004:0.female: This is all thanks to the magister. Of course, Chippy and Hammie helped too!

say:7:1028122005:1.text: Hewynn, are you going back to Lovers' Wish?
say:7:1028122005:1.source_cn: 伊温小姐，你要回情人之愿了吗？

say:8:1028122006:0.text: Can you guys come along? I have something I want to give you.
say:8:1028122006:0.source_cn: 嗯，你们可以一起来吗？我……我有些东西想送给你们。

say:0:1028123001:0.text: Magister, let's go to Lovers' Wish together.
say:0:1028123001:0.source_cn: 主人，那……我们就一起去情人之愿吧？
say:0:1028123001:0.male: Magister, let's go to Lovers' Wish together.
say:0:1028123001:0.female: Magister, let's go to Lovers' Wish together.

say:2:1028124001:0.text: Thank you all. You've done so much for me and this land.
say:2:1028124001:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们，你们为我、为这片丛林做了太多。

say:3:1028124002:0.text: Please accept this. This gift represents my gratitude and sincere wishes.
say:3:1028124002:0.source_cn: 请收下吧。这份礼物代表我对你们的感谢，以及言语无法描述...

say:4:1028124003:0.text: Chippy loves the gift, and thank you for the well wishes!
say:4:1028124003:0.source_cn: 满满喜欢礼物，尤其喜欢伊温小姐的祝福！

choice_prompt:5:1028124003.text: Chippy loves the gift, and thank you for the well wishes!
choice_prompt:5:1028124003.source_cn: 满满喜欢礼物，尤其喜欢伊温小姐的祝福！

choice:5:0:1.text: I have a wish for you, as well.
choice:5:0:1.male: I have a wish for you, as well.
choice:5:0:1.female: I have a wish for you, as well.

say:1:1028125002:0.text: I wish that you and all creatures here, the sun and the rain, and this land...
say:1:1028125002:0.source_cn: 祝你和这里的生灵，祝阳光和雨水，祝这片丛林……
say:1:1028125002:0.male: I wish that you and all creatures here, the sun and the rain, and this land...
say:1:1028125002:0.female: I wish that you and all creatures here, the sun and the rain, and this land...

say:0:1028126001:0.text: will live in peace and tranquility forever...
say:0:1028126001:0.male: will live in peace and tranquility forever...
say:0:1028126001:0.female: will live in peace and tranquility forever...

say:5:1028106001:0.text: After activating the memory fragment, will we see Hewynn's memories? Chippy doesn't think she'll like that...
say:5:1028106001:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐的记忆碎片……激活后，我们也能看到你的回忆吗？...

say:6:1028106002:0.text: No, it's alright... I'll try to absorb the magic. Please maintain the stability of the fragment.
say:6:1028106002:0.source_cn: 不，没关系的……我现在就试着吸收这片魔力，拜托你们维持...

narration:11:1028106004:0.text: A flowing ripple of light emerges. The fragment of the past unfolds before our eyes...
narration:11:1028106004:0.source_cn: 水波般的光芒划过，一段过去的回忆展现在眼前……

say:15:1028106005:0.text: Can nothing be done? I'll beg the sage again or I'll find a healer outside of our lands! I don't believe...
say:15:1028106005:0.source_cn: 真的没办法了吗？我、我去求薄暮丛林的贤者……去丛林之外...

say:16:1028106006:0.text: ...this illness... so many have tried to heal me... even Master Arden couldn't...
say:16:1028106006:0.source_cn: ……我的病……那么多医生都没办法，连雅顿大人都这么说……

say:17:1028106007:0.text: I'm sorry, dear... we've been married for six months, and... I may need to break my promise...
say:17:1028106007:0.source_cn: 对不起，亲爱的……我们结婚才半年，但……我可能做不到对...

say:21:1028106008:0.text: I-I'm born of the waters of the Taran River yet I can't help those who've lived here for generations...
say:21:1028106008:0.source_cn: 我、我是从塔兰河中诞生的精灵，却没法帮助世代生活在这条...

say:22:1028106009:0.text: Water has the power to soothe all ailments, but I'm unable to wield it...
say:22:1028106009:0.source_cn: 水明明有着抚慰一切的力量，可我却无法使用这种力量……

say:23:1028106010:0.text: Why? Because of my cowardice? I'm afraid of new encounters, of strangers... afraid of showing my emotions. Even now, I can't reveal myself to anyone who needs help.
say:23:1028106010:0.source_cn: 为什么呢？因为我的胆怯吗？我害怕陌生的环境和人，害怕坦...

say:24:1028106011:1.text: I... what else can I do?

say:28:1028106012:0.text: Huh? What happened? Hewynn's memory was cut short!
say:28:1028106012:0.source_cn: 诶？发生了什么？伊温小姐的回忆突然中断了！

say:32:1028106014:0.text: Hypofiends! They must be drawn to Hewynn's magic!
say:32:1028106014:0.source_cn: 这些——这些魔物！它们肯定是被伊温小姐逸散的魔力吸引来的！

say:33:1028106015:2.text: Bad monsters! I'll never let them hurt Hewynn or her memories!
say:33:1028106015:2.source_cn: 坏家伙！我绝不会让它们伤害到伊温小姐的宝贵回忆！

say:38:1028107001:0.text: Hewynn, we'll take care of the Hypofiends. Don't be scared.
say:38:1028107001:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐，我们会解决魔物，不要惊慌。
say:38:1028107001:0.male: Hewynn, we'll take care of the Hypofiends. Don't be scared.
say:38:1028107001:0.female: Hewynn, we'll take care of the Hypofiends. Don't be scared.

say:39:1028107002:0.text: Thank you, I'm counting on you...

narration:41:10128115:0.text: Hypofiends enticed by Hewynn's scattered magic are drawn to her, hungry to consume her power. The situation turns perilous.
narration:41:10128115:0.source_cn: 有魔物被伊温流散的魔力吸引了过来，想要吞噬她的力量，情...

narration:42:10128114:0.text: By putting the flower crown in the place where magic disperses, you activate one of Hewynn's memory fragments.
narration:42:10128114:0.source_cn: 你将花冠放到魔力散逸的地方，激活了伊温的记忆碎片。
